cause: The site now mixes relative /images/covers/ paths and absolute CDN URLs. Build 66 returned relative thumbnail_url values verbatim, which cannot construct a native image request.
fix: Resolve cover paths against the selected baseUrl in the production Poster mapping used by both detailed and basic Manga conversion.
